name: io.github.blink1217/quant-swarm
title: quant-swarm
description: Free backtest forensics (lookahead bias, t-stats, cost survival) and hosted PIT SEC/macro data.

tools.name: audit.backtest_inline
tools.description:
Runs a one-shot backtest forensic audit over inline CSV or row arrays with zero server disk I/O.

Built for remote HTTP connectors (claude.ai, ChatGPT, web MCP): evaluates Newey-West HAC
significance, BH q-value, cost survival, concentration, and PIT leakage up to 250 KB.

returns_csv.description: Inline UTF-8 CSV string of strategy returns (columns: ts,strategy_return; max 250 KB).
returns_csv.title: Returns Csv

returns_rows.description: Inline list of strategy return rows [{ts, strategy_return}].
returns_rows.title: Returns Rows

trades_csv.description: Optional inline UTF-8 CSV string of trade records (ts,symbol,pnl_bps,position_pct; max 250 KB).
trades_csv.title: Trades Csv

trades_rows.description: Optional inline trade records [{ts, symbol, pnl_bps, position_pct}].
trades_rows.title: Trades Rows

benchmark_csv.description: Optional inline UTF-8 CSV string of benchmark returns (max 250 KB).
benchmark_csv.title: Benchmark Csv

benchmark_rows.description: Optional inline benchmark return rows [{ts, return}].
benchmark_rows.title: Benchmark Rows

cost_assumptions.description: Optional execution cost assumptions {spread_bps, slippage_bps, adverse_selection_bps, commission_bps}.
cost_assumptions.title: Cost Assumptions

spread_bps.description: Optional one-way spread override in bps.
spread_bps.title: Spread Bps

slippage_bps.description: Optional one-way slippage override in bps.
slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps

adverse_selection_bps.description: Optional one-way adverse selection override in bps.
adverse_selection_bps.title: Adverse Selection Bps

commission_bps.description: Optional one-way commission override in bps.
commission_bps.title: Commission Bps

num_trials.description: Number of strategy/parameter trials tested for BH q-value and Deflated Sharpe adjustment.
num_trials.title: Num Trials

tools.name: warden.audit_features
tools.description:
Audit a feature manifest for lookahead leakage and provenance violations.

manifest: [{name, source, value_ts, as_of}]. Flags banned actuals sources
(open-meteo.archive etc.), features predating tape start, and unknown features fail
closed to tier C. Optional coverage check vs MIN_COVERAGE=0.90 for challenger-selected
symbols against the archived snapshot universe.

manifest.description: Feature manifest: [{name, source, value_ts, as_of}] to audit.
manifest.title: Manifest

tape_started.description: Optional tape start date (YYYY-MM-DD); features predating it are flagged.
tape_started.title: Tape Started

selected_symbols.description: Optional challenger-selected symbols for the coverage check.
selected_symbols.title: Selected Symbols

snapshot_universe.description: Optional archived snapshot universe to measure coverage against.
snapshot_universe.title: Snapshot Universe

tools.name: warden.cost_check
tools.description:
Convert a claimed gross edge into net-of-cost reality under the pessimistic fill model.

Spread + slippage + adverse selection are charged at both entry and exit, always against
the position — the same model the gym scores every episode with.

gross_edge_bps.description: Claimed gross edge in basis points before costs.
gross_edge_bps.title: Gross Edge Bps

adverse_selection_bps.description: Adverse-selection drag in bps (defaults to 0.0 when omitted; echoed in defaults_applied).
adverse_selection_bps.title: Adverse Selection Bps

tools.name: warden.validate_order
tools.description:
Validate a proposed order against the house floors (max position 25%, gross cap 60%).

order: {symbol, notional, side: buy|sell}; current_positions: {symbol: notional}.
Per-fund overrides are allowed but the response always reports the deviation from the
house floors. Rejections quote the exact floor — the same function gating live capital.

equity.description: Account equity (base currency) used for the exposure floors.
equity.title: Equity

current_positions.description: Optional {symbol: notional} map of current positions.
current_positions.title: Current Positions

floor_overrides.description: Optional per-fund overrides {max_position_pct, max_gross_exposure_pct}; the response always reports the deviation from the house floors.
floor_overrides.title: Floor Overrides

tools.name: warden.prop_challenge_check
tools.description:
Checks a proposed trade against TwoStep or OneStep prop-firm drawdown and consistency rules.

Evaluates hard and safe daily loss floors, overall drawdown stop, 30-40% single-day
consistency cap, 0.55x Target-Lock Taper when >=70% of profit target is banked, and
friction-adjusted trade risk. Pure risk/compliance rules — never places orders.

initial_balance.description: Initial prop-challenge evaluation balance in USD.
initial_balance.title: Initial Balance

prev_day_close_equity.description: Previous trading day's closing equity in USD.
prev_day_close_equity.title: Prev Day Close Equity

largest_single_day_profit.description: Largest realized single-day profit so far in the evaluation (USD).
largest_single_day_profit.title: Largest Single Day Profit

proposed_risk_usd.description: Optional proposed dollar stop-loss risk for the next trade.
proposed_risk_usd.title: Proposed Risk Usd

proposed_notional_usd.description: Optional proposed order notional in USD (used for spread/swap friction).
proposed_notional_usd.title: Proposed Notional Usd

format_type.description: Challenge format: 'TwoStep' (default 5% daily / 10% max loss) or 'OneStep' (4% daily / 6% max loss).
format_type.title: Format Type

daily_loss_limit_pct.description: Hard daily drawdown limit fraction (e.g. 0.05 for 5%).
daily_loss_limit_pct.title: Daily Loss Limit Pct

max_loss_limit_pct.description: Hard overall drawdown limit fraction (e.g. 0.10 for 10%).
max_loss_limit_pct.title: Max Loss Limit Pct

consistency_cap_pct.description: Maximum single-day share of total profit allowed by consistency rules (e.g. 0.40 for 40%).
consistency_cap_pct.title: Consistency Cap Pct

spread_bps.description: Estimated round-trip bid-ask spread in basis points.
spread_bps.title: Spread Bps

overnight_swap_bps.description: Estimated daily overnight financing/swap drag in basis points.
overnight_swap_bps.title: Overnight Swap Bps

planned_hold_days.description: Planned holding period in trading days.
planned_hold_days.title: Planned Hold Days

tools.name: warden.defensive_posture
tools.description:
Classifies portfolio risk posture into Normal, Cautious, Defensive, or CrisisShield.

Uses trailing volatility, efficiency ratio, and drawdown stress to compute the
recommended risk-scale multiplier (1.00x down to 0.20x), stop-tightening factor
(1.00x down to 0.55x), and effective portfolio stop-heat cap. Pure risk governance.

benchmark_return_1d_pct.description: Trailing 1-day benchmark return in percent (e.g. -1.25 for -1.25%).
benchmark_return_1d_pct.title: Benchmark Return 1D Pct

realized_vol_20d_pct.description: Trailing 20-day annualized realized volatility in percent.
realized_vol_20d_pct.title: Realized Vol 20D Pct

account_daily_pnl_pct.description: Current account daily PnL in percent.
account_daily_pnl_pct.title: Account Daily Pnl Pct

open_unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Current open portfolio unrealized PnL in percent.
open_unrealized_pnl_pct.title: Open Unrealized Pnl Pct

base_max_stop_heat_pct.description: Baseline maximum aggregate portfolio stop-heat percentage.
base_max_stop_heat_pct.title: Base Max Stop Heat Pct

tools.name: warden.explain_sizing
tools.description:
Step-by-step mirror of the live C# risk engine sizing: ATR sizing, position-notional
cap, overnight-gap halving, weekend gross headroom. Reports the house floors and any
deviation when per-fund overrides are supplied.

atr_14.description: 14-bar average true range of the instrument.
atr_14.title: Atr 14

weekend_approaching.description: True when the position would be held into the weekend (gross headroom applies).
weekend_approaching.title: Weekend Approaching

gross_exposure.description: Current portfolio gross exposure in currency.
gross_exposure.title: Gross Exposure

overnight_gap.description: Expected overnight gap (price units); gaps above 1.2x ATR halve size.
overnight_gap.title: Overnight Gap

floor_overrides.description: Optional per-fund overrides; deviation from house floors is reported.
floor_overrides.title: Floor Overrides

tools.name: pit.analysis
tools.description:
Is this alternative-data signal real for these tickers - or noise?

Explained PIT significance per underlying from the release-gated
pit_analysis/v2 run: each (dataset|metric|horizon) family reports rolling
52-week IR, Newey-West two-sided p, observation count, research-only and
staleness flags, and an explicit verdict - SIGNIFICANT (survives the run's
IR > 0 and BH q <= 0.05 gate), NOT_SIGNIFICANT, below the observation floor,
or UNVERIFIED. Point-in-time, derived-only, no raw values; free lite answers,
Pro gives every family. Not investment advice.

symbols.description: Underlying tickers to query (max 10). Results are per underlying.
symbols.title: Symbols

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD, default today): release points after this date are ignored.
as_of.title: As Of

horizons.description: Subset of the run's horizons, e.g. ['1d','1w','1m','6m'] (default: all).
horizons.title: Horizons

only_significant.description: Only return families with at least one SIGNIFICANT horizon (counts still cover everything).
only_significant.title: Only Significant

max_families.description: Max families returned per underlying, most significant first (1-100).
max_families.title: Max Families

tools.name: market.fundamentals_pit
tools.description:
Returns bitemporal scale-free profitability efficiency, balance-sheet resilience,
and growth acceleration percentiles strictly dated on or before as_of. Includes
filing/insider tone buckets and never echoes raw accounting dollar figures. Pro tool.

symbols.description: Optional list of tickers to evaluate via the shared cache/relay.
symbols.title: Symbols

bars.description: Optional caller-supplied OHLCV rows [{symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume}].
bars.title: Bars

as_of.description: Optional point-in-time cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD); records after this date are masked.
as_of.title: As Of

tools.name: market.insider_institutional_pit
tools.description:
Returns point-in-time insider cluster and institutional flow buckets up to as_of.

Includes filing-gated insider cluster activity, institutional accumulation percentiles,
stealth quiet-session absorption percentiles, and flow-price divergence z-scores. Never
echoes raw share counts or dollar figures. Pro tool.

symbols.description: Optional list of tickers to evaluate via the shared cache/relay.
symbols.title: Symbols

bars.description: Optional caller-supplied OHLCV rows [{symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume}].
bars.title: Bars

as_of.description: Optional point-in-time cutoff date (YYYY-MM-DD); records after this date are masked.
as_of.title: As Of

tools.name: market.regime
tools.description:
Free tool — two-layer causal regime snapshot per symbol with no lookahead.

Combines (1) deterministic `regime` priority label + all active `regime_flags`
and ratio `drivers`, with (2) tempered 4-state forward-filter `latent_state` +
`state_posteriors` (`coherent` crosswalk and `crisis_down` v1.3.0 deprecation).

symbols.description: Optional list of tickers to label via the shared cache/relay.
symbols.title: Symbols

bars.description: Optional caller-supplied OHLCV rows [{symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume}] for symbols the shared cache does not carry.
bars.title: Bars

tools.name: gym.probe_fragility
tools.description:
Replay a genome over the capped episode-seed matrix and surface per-regime fragility.

Returns per-regime net bps, worst regime, turnover, exposure caps, and hard-constraint
violations — never a promotion verdict. Seeds are capped at 8 and per_regime at 2;
tier-B/C mutations against a champion raise the gym's TierScoringRefusal (UNSCORABLE).

genome.description: Genome to replay over the capped episode-seed matrix.
genome.title: Genome

champion_genome.description: Optional champion genome; tier-B/C mutations vs it refuse to score.
champion_genome.title: Champion Genome

symbols.description: Optional tickers from the shared cache; omit when passing bars.
symbols.title: Symbols

min_symbols.description: Minimum symbols for a valid episode pool.
min_symbols.title: Min Symbols
